text: ここから　さきは……　＊　バッジを　もった　もの　だけが　すすめる！

structure.jp: ＊　バッジを　もった　もの　だけが
structure.en: only those who have the ＊ Badge

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ＊　バッジを　もった　もの
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a word describes that word. バッジを　もった　もの = 'a person who has the Badge'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb's ending to the e-sound plus る says 'can do'. すすむ 'go forward' becomes すすめる. すすめる = 'can go forward'.

patterns.name: 〜だけ
patterns.explanation: だけ after a word means 'only that and nothing else'. もの　だけが = 'only those people'.
